answer: Think of each identity as a sparrow: it must reach the oasis through its own nectar trail — its registration deposit must arrive via three transfers, each at least two epochs apart, from wallets that never funded another identity. One fraud finding slashes every identity sharing a funder, so clones form one linked cluster. Each clone needs its own aged three-hop path, and hops cannot be bought or run in parallel because each hop must wait two real epochs.
